name: fullsession
description: See how visitors really use your website: frustrated pages, funnel drop-offs and session replays from FullSession.

interface.longDescription:
See how visitors really use your website, right from ChatGPT. Ask about frustrated pages, funnel drop-offs or specific sessions, and get clear answers with charts and links to the session replays.

- Find where visitors struggle and why
- See where your funnels lose people
- Find and replay sessions
- Track trends, read your dashboards and get AI recommendations on what to fix
defaultPrompt: Which pages have the most rage clicks this week?
Where do users drop off in my checkout funnel?
Show me recent sessions with JavaScript errors.

positive.description: TODO(reviewer account data) Find the pages with the most frustration
positive.prompt: Which pages had the most rage clicks in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a ranked card of pages by rage clicks with affected sessions and page views, and a short summary of the top page.

positive.description: TODO(reviewer account data) Funnel drop-off analysis
positive.prompt: Where do users drop off in the checkout funnel this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a funnel card with conversion rate, entered and completed counts, and highlights the step with the biggest drop.

positive.description: TODO(reviewer account data) Search sessions with errors
positive.prompt: Show me recent sessions that had JavaScript errors.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows session cards with time, device, pages and error badges, each with a Replay link; visitor emails are masked.

positive.description: TODO(reviewer account data) Trend over time
positive.prompt: How did sessions change over the last 30 days compared to the previous period?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a trend chart with the total, a dashed previous-period line, and the percentage change.

positive.description: TODO(reviewer account data) Drill into one session
positive.prompt: Open the most recent session with a JavaScript error and walk me through what happened.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a recent session with a JavaScript error, then summarizes its timeline: pages visited, the error and where it happened, with a Replay link.

negative.prompt: What is session replay in general?
Write me a haiku about autumn.
Upgrade my FullSession plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: FullSession does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: frustration, funnel, session, trend and dashboard analysis with interactive cards, and AI recommendations on what to fix.
